assumptions.choice: Each supplied 1-minute OHLCV bar is treated as one tick, using its Close as the tick price and Volume as the tick volume.
assumptions.reason: The fixed execution environment supplies 1-minute bars rather than individual ticks.

assumptions.choice: Each entry order targets 1% of current broker portfolio value at signal time, converted to units using the current Close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires 1% of total trading capital but does not define whether capital is initial or mark-to-market value.

assumptions.choice: Up to three same-direction entry lots are tracked; Backtrader represents them as one net position, and any exit closes that net position.
assumptions.reason: A single Backtrader data feed exposes aggregate position state rather than separately addressable simultaneous positions on the same instrument.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit use Backtrader's aggregate position average entry price when multiple entry lots are open.
assumptions.reason: The environment provides one aggregate position price for the instrument.

assumptions.choice: The first five minutes are interpreted as bars timestamped 09:30 through 09:34 inclusive; trading begins at 09:35.
assumptions.reason: The supplied data is regular-session AAPL data beginning at 09:30.

assumptions.choice: Order execution cannot occur at the instant a bar's Close is received; submitted orders follow the harness's normal Backtrader execution timing.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader bar-based execution cannot reproduce zero-latency real-time tick order execution exactly.
